{{Top|leg}}
The '''Republic Mercy Corps''' was an organization that served as volunteers in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Military/Legends|military]]. The [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] never refused to let a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] assist in the Mercy Corps. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] organized his [[Revanchist|followers]] under the banner of the Mercy Corps, which caused the Council to officially sanction his Jedi's involvement in the [[Mandalorian Wars]].
